slug: 2025-05-01 A Blueprint for Mauritius - Digital Transformation 2025-2029

facts.fact: The excerpt calls the Blueprint the Government of Mauritius's Digital Transformation Blueprint for 2025-2029, 'unveiled in May 2025' and setting out the national programme; it names no adopting act or body.

systems.system: A Blueprint for Mauritius - A Bridge to the Future (Digital Transformation Blueprint 2025-2029)

note: Short excerpt only; the 'national' class rests on the excerpt's wording 'national programme to modernise Mauritius's digital ecosystem' covering government portal, data protection, cyber, AI, e-commerce and SME support.
